PROJ.title: Real-Time Vehicle Tracking Backend
PROJ.sum: A backend for receiving, storing and serving vehicle location and trip data through REST APIs.
PROJ.problem: Vehicle location and trip data has to be received, stored and served to client applications in a structured way.
PROJ.sol: Spring Boot REST APIs on top of a MySQL schema covering vehicles, devices and location records.
work: Designing the MySQL schema for vehicles, devices and location records
Building and working with REST APIs
Managing builds and dependencies with Maven
PROJ.note: Still being built, so features are not described as complete.

PROJ.title: Solar Panel Defect Detection System
PROJ.sum: An AI-based system that detects solar panel defects from electroluminescence images.
PROJ.problem: Defects in solar panels are hard to spot by eye in electroluminescence images.
PROJ.sol: A YOLOv8 detection workflow served through FastAPI, with a React interface for uploading images and viewing predictions.
work: Implementing the YOLOv8-based defect detection workflow
Developing FastAPI endpoints for model inference
Building the React interface for image upload and prediction display
Connecting the frontend to the inference service
PROJ.note: No accuracy figures are shown, because none are verified here.

PROJ.title: ISRO Reliability Portal
PROJ.sum: A web portal to estimate, evaluate and manage system reliability data, built during my ISRO SDSC SHAR internship.
PROJ.problem: Reliability data needed one place to be estimated, evaluated, stored and reported on, inside an isolated internal network.
PROJ.sol: A browser interface calls Spring Boot REST endpoints, which use JdbcTemplate and SQL queries to store, retrieve and report data.
work: Front end in HTML, CSS and JavaScript
Spring Boot backend logic and REST endpoints
JdbcTemplate/JDBC and SQL for storage, retrieval and reports
Testing on an isolated LAN and writing documentation
PROJ.note: Internal project: no public repository or demo exists, and no internal material is shown.
